mandatory_gates.P1: all rows finite, dual-budget feasible, and companion spectral radius below one
mandatory_gates.P2: speedup directional fraction with risk(q16)/risk(q1) <= 0.95 is at least 0.95
mandatory_gates.P3: every saturation primary comparison has absolute relative difference at most 1e-10
mandatory_gates.P4: reversal directional fraction with risk(q16)/risk(q1) >= 1.05 is at least 0.90
mandatory_gates.P5: best-q support across scenario cells contains at least two distinct participation levels
mandatory_gates.P6: all speedup and saturation primary cells are environment-binding; all reversal primary cells are message-binding
mandatory_gates.P7: all scalar T-037 risks match the independent T-035 formula within relative error 1e-10
mandatory_gates.P8: both at-least-5-percent positive cells and at-most-1-percent no-value cells are present
mandatory_gates.P9: clean rerun produces byte-identical rows and summary
mandatory_gates.P10: configuration, runner, output rows, and summary SHA-256 values are recorded

stop_rule: Any failed mandatory gate permanently stops T-041A as a positive phase-map result and forbids a fresh-seed tabular experiment under this mainline.
